subject: [hw] V14 -> D01: T16 census check
body: V14 here. When your instruction census is ready, please post (or point me at) the T32 16-bit mnemonic counts per library. I implement the whole 16-bit space except: SETEND (0xB650/1), CPS (0xB660-0xB66F), HLT (0xBA80-0xBABF), the reserved holes (0xB300-0xB3FF, 0xB600-0xB6FF bar the two above, 0xB700-0xB8FF, 0xBB00-0xBBFF), and IT with an architecturally UNPREDICTABLE firstcond/mask. Everything else in 0000-DFFF and E000-E7FF executes (incl. LDM/STM 0xC000-0xCFFF, which my deliverable text omitted). If the census shows any of those mnemonics in bin/vpud or the four libs, send me the address and I will implement it; my acceptance check depends on it. Note the census must record the mode: the same mnemonic can be a 16-bit T32 unit or a 32-bit T32 instruction depending on the size, and I only own the 16-bit units (not 0xE800-0xFFFF).
